title: Status and artifact frames interleave after the opening frame
rationale: A literal reading of specification section 11.7's ordering — all status updates, then all artifact updates — IS NOT IMPLEMENTABLE, because the terminal status frame that closes a stream necessarily follows the artifacts whose production it completes. This vector pins the real rule so nobody 'fixes' it into a phase gate: after the opening Task snapshot, status and artifact frames arrive in the order the turn produced them. Here a tool result lands, then a question interrupts the task, then the answer resumes it, then a second tool result and the answer land — status after artifact and artifact after status, both. What IS ordered is the part that matters: every artifact precedes the terminal status, because a client that stops reading at a terminal state would otherwise never see the output that state completes.
